title: SVG ‘must never become numb to acts of bloodshed’ – Christian Council
summary: iWitness News reports that a September 25 shooting in Green Hill, St. Vincent and the Grenadines, killed four people and injured four. Its October 2 report describes a Christian Council appeal for calm and a thorough investigation. A continuing threat and an exact administrative area have not been established.
